messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: page fired for service="inference-prod" severity=high — embeddings-api 5xx rate spike detected (sustained >60s). link: https://pd/r/INC-3305 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Auto-assign attempted — no rotation match, posting to #incidents.
emma_oncall: acked — i’m on it, ETA 5m. pulling logs. :thumbsup:
ben_oncall: if you need handoff i can take next. currently on a deploy but can step in.
carla_support: CSM ping: multiple customers reported degraded embeddings this morning. we have 3 open tickets with higher priority.
dave_infra: seeing elevated 503s from embedder-hosts in eu-west-1. qps steady but error-rate up. looks like transient OOM on node pool. tailing logs now:
alice_sre: logs show repeated kernel OOM on container: oom_kill process=python3 memory=30GB
emma_oncall: ok, scaling up pool and draining affected nodes. initiating rolling-restart on embedder-asg, will enable fallback route to smaller quantized model during restart.
ben_oncall: noted. switching routing to model:embed-quant-v2 for 10% of traffic as fallback: `route set fallback embed-quant-v2 --pct 10`
dave_infra: scaling started (requested +4 instances). draining nodes shows connection churn — adding graceful-drain=60s.
carla_support: update for CSMs: telling customers we have a mitigation in progress and will follow up with timeline in 15m.
emma_oncall: initial mitigation active. error-rate dropping from 5.4% -> 1.1% in last 90s. continuing to monitor.
alice_sre: adding temporary alert suppression for duplicate pages for 10m while we stabilize: `incidentbot suppress dup-pages 10m reason=scale-restart`
ben_oncall: taking ownership for follow-up post-stabilization (will own root-cause). emma handing back to ben in 5. Marking PD assignment -> @ben_oncall. :white_check_mark:
emma_oncall: handoff acknowledged. tagging runbook: inference-embed-oom v2-ops.
dave_infra: once stable will collect /var/log/oom_kill and kernel logs and upload to the incident folder.
carla_support: quantifying customer impact: approx 3% of embedding calls failed across prod for 12m window, affecting ~18 customers; highest impact on real-time pipelines.
emma_oncall: next steps: ben to run postmortem, dave to attach infra logs, alice to verify alert thresholds to avoid noisy pages. ETA for postmortem draft: 48h.
ben_oncall: ack, will start the RCA draft and include mitigation timeline. ping me if anything regresses.
incidentbot: Incident updated — status=stabilized, assigned=ben_oncall, severity=high -> monitoring. notifications sent to infra/sre/product.
